title: Tall, but the lid is questionable
text: Tall, but the lid is questionable. This cold brew container seems pretty large compared to others I have seen on the market, but the size comes as a disadvantage in this shape.  It’s tall and for most refrigerators this is no problem, but it doesn’t leave you many options if your shelves aren’t set up to accommodate this height.  I like the glass, it seems heavy, but the lid is a problem.  The lid is held in place by a rubber fitting which I found to be too loose.  I would have liked to have been able to bring this to work with me, but the lid would not be water tight.  The filter seems to be high quality, but after asking my barista to set the grinder to ‘coarse’, I still saw plenty of coffee residue in the bottom of the container.  I’ll probably end up storing this thing under a cabinet somewhere, but others might find it more of a convenient system.
